name: Shortwave
description: A far radio station on every key: a whistle that slides in to the note, fades and returns, warbles, sends pips or murmurs, over static that stops when you do.

params.name: Signal
params.description: What each station sends. Whistle is a pure tone, Warble swaps between two tones, Pips are short soft pulses, Voices is breath on the note that murmurs like far speech.

params.name: Tune in
params.description: How far off pitch each note starts and how long it takes to slide in, like a dial being turned. Low settings are a quick chirp. At its lowest the note is in tune at once.

params.name: Drift
params.description: How far each station wanders slowly around its note once it has arrived. Low settings barely move; the highest reach a quarter tone either way.

params.name: Rate
params.description: How often Warble changes tone and Pips pulse, and how many syllables a second Voices murmurs. It does nothing on Whistle.

params.name: Shift
params.description: The second tone that Warble swaps to, always an octave or two away from the played note. It is only heard on Warble.

params.name: Fading
params.description: How deeply each station sinks and swells over seconds, with a hollow notch that sweeps differently on each side and spreads the sound. At its lowest the level is steady.

params.name: Beat
params.description: Adds a fainter station a few hertz above each note, so the two throb against each other. Higher is a faster throb. On Voices it is a faint whistle under the breath.

params.name: Static
params.description: Hiss and sparse crackle under the stations. It rises with the keys and dies away with them, so the instrument is silent when nothing is played.

params.name: Band
params.description: How narrow the receiver is. Low settings are open and full; high settings thin everything to a small telephone band, which also quietens very low and very high notes.

params.name: Attack
params.description: How long a station takes to come up out of the noise when a key is pressed.

params.name: Release
params.description: How long a station takes to sink away after the key is released. The static goes with it.

params.name: Volume
params.description: Output level of the instrument. A soft clip after it rounds off the peaks when many notes stack up.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit. It models what a listener hears on a shortwave receiver at night (a carrier whistle found by tuning, two tone and pulsed signals, speech off tune, fading, a neighbouring carrier, static) as a playable tone source; propagation is reduced to a slow gain and a notch per side, and speech to bands of noise on the note's harmonics under two formants that change a syllable at a time. It is not a model of any one instrument, receiver or product.
